# Sathika Hettiarachchi — Network Engineer × Software Developer

> Computer Networks graduate building distributed systems, network security tooling
> and full-stack applications. Site: https://hetti219.github.io

## Project Inventory

- [DTVN — Distributed Ticket Validation Network](https://hetti219.github.io/#registry)
  path: /network/consensus/dtvn
  Byzantine fault-tolerant P2P ticket validation in Go. PBFT consensus, gossip
  dissemination with Bloom filter deduplication, Kademlia DHT discovery, vector
  clocks. Tolerates f < n/3 Byzantine nodes. ~12,800 lines, ~8,300 lines of tests.
  Stack: Go, libp2p, PBFT, Protobuf, BoltDB, D3.js, WebSocket
  Source: https://github.com/Hetti219/DTVN

- [TCP SYN Flood Detector](https://hetti219.github.io/#registry)
  path: /security/kernel/tcp-syn-flood-detector
  Userspace C11 daemon for real-time DDoS detection and mitigation via
  netfilter/NFQUEUE. 65,000+ packets/sec at ~45ms detection latency. 13 test
  suites with AFL++ fuzzing and CodeQL scanning.
  Stack: C, Linux Kernel, netfilter, NFQUEUE, ipset, BPF, Meson
  Source: https://github.com/Hetti219/TCP-SYN-Flood-Detector

- [EXIF Toolkit](https://hetti219.github.io/#registry)
  path: /security/mobile/exif-toolkit
  Flutter/Firebase mobile app for viewing, editing and stripping EXIF metadata
  from images, for digital forensics and privacy.
  Stack: Flutter, Dart, Firebase
  Source: https://github.com/Hetti219/EXIF_toolkit

- [MaskBook](https://hetti219.github.io/#registry)
  path: /fullstack/web/maskbook
  Full-stack social platform with authentication and real-time interactions.
  Stack: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL
  Live: https://mask-book.atwebpages.com/
